items.text: Boat scientists now only pursue visible players, switch targets if blocked, give up after long chases, limit pursuit distance, and stop when no crew sees the target.

Fixed multiple item handling bugs: Water Purifier no longer stacks garbage, Research Table retains item definitions, ItemContainer.Clear properly invalidates items, and Cookable items cache data before destruction, preventing cooking errors.
Increased default item pool size from 512 to 2,048, reducing overflow and improving loot variety.
Adjusted random gutting bonuses for several fish and swapped a cloth drop chance for a blueprint fragment, adding more valuable loot.
Added blueprint fragments and pages to underwater crates, aligning them with other loot sources.
Security cameras now work again after fixing an infinite power configuration bug.
Sprinklers and radwater effects improved: reliable splash, stable fuel type, correct water visuals, and support for water guns/pistols.
Animal fences and gates can now be placed on sloped terrain more easily.
Scrap king roof colliders adjusted for smoother building interactions.
Added extra line-of-sight position for ramps, fixing LOS blockage.
Cows can meet their light requirement using lamps, simplifying livestock care.
Death-screen sleeping bag button size and overlap fixed, reducing misclicks.
Bags assigned while dead now appear on the map immediately, preventing loss of visibility after death or rejoin.

2026-10-26.summary:
### AI & Enemy Behavior
- Boat scientists now only pursue visible players, switch targets if blocked, give up after long chases, limit pursuit distance, and stop when no crew sees the target.

### Item Management & Loot
- Fixed multiple item handling bugs: Water Purifier no longer stacks garbage, Research Table retains item definitions, ItemContainer.Clear properly invalidates items, and Cookable items cache data before destruction, preventing cooking errors.
- Increased default item pool size from 512 to 2,048, reducing overflow and improving loot variety.
- Adjusted random gutting bonuses for several fish and swapped a cloth drop chance for a blueprint fragment, adding more valuable loot.
- Added blueprint fragments and pages to underwater crates, aligning them with other loot sources.

### Base Building & Utilities
- Security cameras now work again after fixing an infinite power configuration bug.
- Sprinklers and radwater effects improved: reliable splash, stable fuel type, correct water visuals, and support for water guns/pistols.
- Animal fences and gates can now be placed on sloped terrain more easily.
- Scrap king roof colliders adjusted for smoother building interactions.
- Added extra line-of-sight position for ramps, fixing LOS blockage.

### Livestock & Animals
- Cows can meet their light requirement using lamps, simplifying livestock care.

### UI & Map Improvements
- Death-screen sleeping bag button size and overlap fixed, reducing misclicks.
- Bags assigned while dead now appear on the map immediately, preventing loss of visibility after death or rejoin.

items.text: Animal repellant buff now only affects sharks (they flee) and bee swarms (they won't chase); bulls and rams ignore the buff and will neither flee nor charge.
Chickens on the tutorial island no longer act aggressively.
Sunflower seed-stage plants can now be cleared reliably with a melee weapon.
Child livestock can leave their mother's leash radius to eat from a trough, preventing them from getting stuck hungry in pens.
Building planner now shows the specific blocker name instead of a generic "Cannot build in this area" message.
Ramp placement improved: aiming at the center of a foundation now places ramps correctly.
Wrapping paper can no longer be filled with water, preventing unintended item behavior.

2026-10-25.summary:
### Animals & AI
- Animal repellant buff now only affects sharks (they flee) and bee swarms (they won't chase); bulls and rams ignore the buff and will neither flee nor charge.
- Chickens on the tutorial island no longer act aggressively.

### Farming
- Sunflower seed-stage plants can now be cleared reliably with a melee weapon.
- Child livestock can leave their mother's leash radius to eat from a trough, preventing them from getting stuck hungry in pens.

### Building & UI
- Building planner now shows the specific blocker name instead of a generic "Cannot build in this area" message.
- Ramp placement improved: aiming at the center of a foundation now places ramps correctly.

### Bug Fixes
- Wrapping paper can no longer be filled with water, preventing unintended item behavior.
